name: icron-llm-visibility

scripts.db:init:local: wrangler d1 execute icron-visibility --local --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute icron-visibility --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed_prompts.sql && npm run migrate:local
scripts.db:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute icron-visibility --remote --file=./migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute icron-visibility --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_prompts.sql && npm run migrate:remote
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types test/brands.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types test/batch.test.ts && node test/cf-setup.test.mjs
